methodology.quantiles: P50 median; P95/P99 nearest rank ceil(p*N); no discarded outliers
methodology.samples: maximum rank for each iteration, then pool both reversed-order passes
methodology.performance_checks: environment variable absent and every rank checked_repetitions==0
methodology.formal: 10 warmups +30 measured per pass, 2 reversed passes per case/implementation
methodology.focused: 10 warmups +100 measured per pass, 2 reversed passes
methodology.scope: per-call allocation/input clones/Notify/Forward with retained training state; untimed rank barrier; no profiler or compilation
methodology.residual: wall-max - notify-max - forward-max is a lower bound, not exact same-rank decomposition
